Paano mag-combine ng dalawang queries ga: Paano i-combine ang results nang may duplicates?
SELECT name FROM users UNION SELECT name: SELECT name FROM users UNION ALL SELECT name FROM admins;

Paano mag-combine ng dalawang queries ga: Paano makuha ang rows na nasa parehong queries?
SELECT name FROM users UNION SELECT name: SELECT id FROM orders INTERSECT SELECT order_id FROM payments;

Paano mag-combine ng dalawang queries ga: Paano makuha ang rows na wala sa pangalawang query?
SELECT name FROM users UNION SELECT name: SELECT id FROM users EXCEPT SELECT user_id FROM banned;
I-add ang ORDER BY sa dulo ng buong UNION query.
